gre_0001.content: Thank you for calling MetroBoost, this is [Agent Name], your wireless specialist. How can I assist you today?

clo_0002.content: Thank you so much for being a valued part of the MetroBoost family, [Customer Name]. If you ever need anything, do not hesitate to call us back. Have a wonderful day!

req_0003.content: Ask for the customer's full name.

req_0004.content: Ask for the mobile number on the account.

req_0005.content: Ask for the 4-digit account security PIN.

hol_0006.content: May I please place you on a brief hold while I look into this for you?

hol_0007.content: I'll be back with you in no more than two minutes.

hol_0008.content: Thank you so much for your patience, [Customer Name].

tra_0009.content: Explain why the transfer is needed.

tra_0010.content: Name the department they're sending the customer to.

tra_0011.content: Offer to stay on the line until the other department picks up.

tra_0012.content: Give the customer a direct callback number in case the transfer drops.

esc_0013.content: Escalate to a supervisor immediately if the customer explicitly asks for a supervisor or manager.

esc_0014.content: Escalate to a supervisor immediately if the customer mentions filing a complaint with the FCC, BBB, or any regulatory body.

esc_0015.content: Escalate to a supervisor immediately if the issue can't be resolved after two genuine attempts.

esc_0016.content: Escalate to a supervisor immediately if the customer has been calling about the same unresolved issue for more than 3 contacts.

man_0017.content: Just to let you know, this call may be recorded for quality assurance and training purposes.

man_0018.content: Before I make this change, I want to confirm: [describe the change and billing impact].

man_0020.content: By enrolling in O2Pay, you authorize MetroBoost to automatically charge your selected payment method each billing cycle.

man_0021.content: You can cancel AutoPay at any time through the MetroBoost app or by calling us.

pro_0026.content: You should have read the terms.

pro_0029.content: Metro Basic plan features unlimited domestic calls and texts.

pro_0030.content: Metro Basic plan includes 10GB of high-speed LTE data.

pro_0031.content: Metro Basic plan does not include hotspot data.

pro_0032.content: Metro Basic plan does not include taxes.

pro_0034.content: Metro Unlimited plan features unlimited calls, texts, and data.

pro_0035.content: Metro Unlimited plan includes 15GB of hotspot data.

pro_0038.content: Metro Plus plan features everything in Metro Unlimited, plus international calls to 20 countries.

pro_0039.content: Metro Plus plan includes 30GB of hotspot data.

pro_0040.content: Metro Plus plan includes one year of partner streaming subscription.

pro_0042.content: International Add-On plan adds international calling to 50+ countries to any plan.

cur_0043.content: Customers who enroll in O2Pay get $5 off their monthly bill.

cur_0044.content: O2Pay discount starts from the second billing cycle after enrollment.

cur_0045.content: O2Pay discount is not applied retroactively.

cur_0046.content: O2Pay discount is removed from the next billing cycle after cancellation.

cur_0047.content: New customers who bring an unlocked device and activate Metro Unlimited or Metro Plus get a one-time $25 credit on their third billing cycle.

cur_0048.content: Existing customers earn $15 credit per friend who activates a plan and stays active for 30 days.

cur_0049.content: Existing customers earn $10 off their first month for each friend who activates a plan.

cur_0050.content: Customers switching from a competitor who port their number and activate Metro Unlimited or Metro Plus get a $30 bill credit on the second billing cycle.

pol_0051.content: MetroBoost bills in advance, each payment covers the next 30 days.

pol_0052.content: Agents cannot issue refunds over $20 without supervisor approval.

pol_0053.content: Customers can cancel anytime, prepaid balances are non-refundable.

pol_0054.content: Porting from MetroBoost to another carrier closes the account automatically, takes 2–4 hours weekdays, up to 24 hours weekends.

com_0055.content: Billing discrepancy: Pull up the account, review the last statement, identify the charge breakdown, compare to what the customer expected, issue a credit and document the cause if there's a real discrepancy.

com_0056.content: Bank overdraft fee: MetroBoost is not responsible, offer a one-time $5 courtesy credit for customers who've been with us 12+ months, subject to supervisor approval.

com_0057.content: AutoPay not working: Check if the card on file is expired, check if the card has sufficient funds, walk them through re-enrolling AutoPay in the MetroBoost app, escalate to billing tier 2 if still broken.

con_0058.content: Customer Care: 1-800-METRO-01, Monday–Saturday 7am–10pm local time, Sunday 9am–7pm.

con_0061.content: MetroBoost App: iOS App Store and Google Play, search 'MetroBoost'.

fre_0064.content: Why is my bill higher than my plan price?

fre_0065.content: The Metro Basic ($40) doesn't include taxes, taxes add $2–$4 depending on your state.

fre_0066.content: Does the $65 plan really include taxes?

fre_0067.content: Yes, the only extra you might see is a one-time $5 activation fee if you're a new customer.

fre_0068.content: When does the AutoPay discount kick in?

fre_0069.content: The $5 discount starts on your second billing cycle after enrollment.

fre_0071.content: The $5 discount is removed from the next billing cycle after cancellation.

fre_0072.content: Can I switch from postpaid to prepaid and keep my number?

fre_0073.content: Yes, we port your number over, takes 2–4 hours weekdays, up to 24 hours weekends.

ton_0074.content: Use a warm, professional, and empathetic tone.

emp_0082.content: Never tell them they 'shouldn't feel that way'.

con_0086.content: Close with a concrete next step.

con_0087.content: Offer a supervisor callback if necessary.

con_0088.content: Never hang up without supervisor approval.

res_0089.content: An issue is resolved when the customer confirms satisfaction.

res_0090.content: A credit/correction is issued and acknowledged.

res_0091.content: If not resolved, create a ticket.

res_0093.content: Log the call in the CRM.
